infobox.usage: Unlocks a door at the skybridge which connects the Primorsky 46 and 48 buildings on Streets of Tarkov.

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Primorsky 46-48 skybridge key (Skybridge) is a Key in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: A key to the skybridge linking Primorsky 46-48, leads to the apartment of the ballet master.

sections.heading: Notes
sections.text: - Cannot be listed for sale on the flea market.

sections.heading: Quests
sections.text: - This is a required location for the quests Ballet Lover, Audiophile and Spotter

sections.heading: Key Location
sections.text:
- In Jackets
- In Drawers
- Pockets and bags of Scavs

sections.heading: Streets of Tarkov
sections.text: Inside the "Brodion" pub, on the shelf behind the bar counter. A single key is guaranteed to spawn every raid.

sections.heading: Lock Location
sections.text: Door to the Primorsky 48 apartment no. 10 at the skybridge which connects it with the Primorsky 46 staircase at Streets of Tarkov. The apartment 10 entrance door can be breached from the inside to leave.
